ac_verdicts.ac: AC1 Fix now links task; In progress box; Resolve replaces Fix now/Promote/Snooze
ac_verdicts.reason: Fix-now intent carries triageItemId, sent as fixNowForTriageId on create and stored by the create route. The card renders TriageTaskBox with title, state and Open task link, and swaps the Fix now / Promote / Snooze row for Resolve.

ac_verdicts.ac: AC2 In progress tile and removable chip
ac_verdicts.reason: inProgress counts open entries keyed projectId:triageId in the linked set built from tasks that are not done. The prog tile narrows the list and the chip says In progress.

ac_verdicts.ac: AC3 Dismiss cross opens popup with optional reason; nothing until confirmed
ac_verdicts.reason: The cross is a popover trigger and dismiss runs only from the Dismiss button or Enter. Cancel closes without calling dismiss; an empty reason is sent as null. Tests cover confirm, cancel and rejection.

ac_verdicts.ac: AC4 Campaign help for req3-campaign + reviewable help list in spec folder
ac_verdicts.reason: SOURCE_HELP_ALIAS maps req3-campaign to the req3 help. The generated triage-help-texts.md is kept in sync with the code by triageHelpDoc.test.ts.

summary: All four ACs are implemented as written. Out-of-scope items respected. One small addition: an operator source help text, in keeping with the help-list AC.
